name: Wakabayashi Kyoutarou
source: Kyoutarou is [url=https://vndb.org/c3131]Mie[/url]'s older brother. He is a psychologist at Tokiwa's hospital and he regularly gets visited by [url=https://vndb.org/c12869]Yoshikazu[/url]. [spoiler]He used to have a crush on Yoshikazu's girlfirend, [url=https://vndb.org/c3134]Touko[/url], but whether he got over it remains a question that only he can answer himself.[/spoiler]
